description: This is a documentation source file (Markdown) for the RDKShell plugin API, describing the plugin's methods, their parameters, responses, and events. It provides detailed API specifications for controlling applications within the Thunder framework.

methods.name: addAnimation
methods.description: Performs the set of animations.

methods.name: addKeyIntercept
methods.description: Adds a key intercept to the client application specified.

methods.name: addKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Adds the list of key intercepts.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a key listener to an application.

methods.name: addKeyMetadataListener
methods.description: Adds the key metadata listeners.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display for the specified client using the configuration parameters.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys an application.

methods.name: enableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting and events.

methods.name: enableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeats.

methods.name: enableLogsFlushing
methods.description: Enables or disables flushing all logs.

methods.name: enableVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Enables or disables a virtual display for the specified client.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Triggers the key events (key press and release).

methods.name: getAvailableTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of application types available on the firmware.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Gets the bounds of the specified client.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Gets a list of clients.

methods.name: getCursorSize
methods.description: Returns the currently set cursor size.

methods.name: getHolePunch
methods.description: Returns whether video hole punching is enabled or disabled for the specified client.

methods.name: getKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether key repeating is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKey
methods.description: Returns the last key press prior to a device wakeup.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the currently set logging level.

methods.name: getLogsFlushingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether log flushing is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: getOpacity
methods.description: Gets the opacity of the specified client.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale of an application.

methods.name: getScreenResolution
methods.description: Gets the screen resolution.

methods.name: getScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state of all applications.

methods.name: getSystemMemory
methods.description: Gets the information of System Memory.

methods.name: getSystemResourceInfo
methods.description: Returns system resource information about each application.

methods.name: getVirtualDisplayEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether virtual display is enabled or disabled for the specified client.

methods.name: getVirtualResolution
methods.description: Returns the virtual display resolution for the specified client.

methods.name: getVisibility
methods.description: Gets the visibility of the specified client.

methods.name: getZOrder
methods.description: Returns an array of clients in Z order, starting with the top most application client first.

methods.name: getGraphicsFrameRate
methods.description: Returns the current Graphics Frame Rate.

methods.name: hideAllClients
methods.description: Hides/Unhides all the clients.

methods.name: hideCursor
methods.description: Hides the cursor from showing on the display.

methods.name: hideFullScreenImage
methods.description: Hides the Full Screen Image.

methods.name: hideSplashLogo
methods.description: Removes the splash screen.

methods.name: ignoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Blocks user key inputs.

methods.name: injectKey
methods.description: Injects the keys.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the specified client.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an application.

methods.name: launchApplication
methods.description: Launches an application.

methods.name: launchResidentApp
methods.description: Launches the Resident application.

methods.name: moveBehind
methods.description: Moves the specified client behind the specified target client.

methods.name: moveToBack
methods.description: Moves the specified client to the back or bottom of the Z order.

methods.name: moveToFront
methods.description: Moves the specified client to the front or top of the Z order.

methods.name: removeAllKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Removes all key intercepts.

methods.name: removeAllKeyListeners
methods.description: Removes all key listeners.

methods.name: removeAnimation
methods.description: Removes the current animation for the specified client.

methods.name: removeKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept.

methods.name: removeKeyListener
methods.description: Removes a key listener for an application.

methods.name: removeKeyMetadataListener
methods.description: Removes the key metadata listeners.

methods.name: resetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets the inactivity notification interval.

methods.name: resumeApplication
methods.description: Resumes an application.

methods.name: scaleToFit
methods.description: Scales the specified client to fit the current bounds.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Sets the bounds of the specified client.

methods.name: setCursorSize
methods.description: Sets the cursor size.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the specified client.

methods.name: setHolePunch
methods.description: Enables or disables video hole punching for the specified client.

methods.name: setInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity notification interval.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the logging level.

methods.name: setMemoryMonitor
methods.description: Enables or disables RAM memory monitoring on the device and configures thresholds.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the specified client.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Scales an application.

methods.name: setScreenResolution
methods.description: Sets the screen resolution.

methods.name: setTopmost
methods.description: Sets whether the specified client appears above all other clients on the display.

methods.name: setVirtualResolution
methods.description: Sets the virtual resolution for the specified client.

methods.name: setVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether the specified client should be visible.

methods.name: setGraphicsFrameRate
methods.description: Set Graphics Frame Rate.

methods.name: showCursor
methods.description: Shows the cursor on the display using the current cursor size.

methods.name: showFullScreenImage
methods.description: Shows the Full Screen Image.

methods.name: showSplashLogo
methods.description: Displays the splash screen.

methods.name: showWatermark
methods.description: Sets whether a watermark shows on the display.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends an application.

methods.name: suspendApplication
methods.description: Suspends an application.

methods.name: keyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Customizes key repeats.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: adds/removes the list of applications with the given callsigns to/from the blacklist.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Gets a list of blacklisted clients.
